paragraphs.text: OlaChill Japan travel services for DeepSeek Harness
# OlaChill for DeepSeek Harness
Find and price Japan travel services from OlaChill inside DeepSeek Harness (dsh): tours and day trip
s, activities, attraction and transport tickets, ryokan, private airport transfers, cars with driver
, charter buses, helicopter flights, golf and Japan eSIM.
This is a configuration-only dsh bundle. It inserts dsh's built-in MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp
-client`) pointed at OlaChill's public MCP server, `https://olachill.com/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). It
contains no code and needs no API key.
